package e2e

// 社交模块真实验收：只经 PB / account RPC 驱动，毒性代理和文件栅栏仅改变时序。
// Team 仍归 game 的 Remote 共享实体；Q4 的旧驻留副本写隔离不在本用例结论内。
import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	apperrors "example.com/planet/internal/errors"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/msgid"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/errcode"
	svcaccount "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
)

func teamInfo(p *player) *pb.TeamResponse {
	return call(p, msgid.MsgTeamInfo, &pb.TeamInfoRequest{}, pb.MarshalTeamInfoRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
}

func requireTeam(t *testing.T, got *pb.TeamResponse, id, leader, revision int64, members ...int64) {
	t.Helper()
	slices.Sort(members)
	if got.Code != 0 || got.Info == nil || got.Info.TeamID != id || got.Info.Leader != leader || got.Info.Revision != revision || !slices.Equal(got.Info.Members, members) {
		t.Fatalf("TEAM_AUTHORITY: got %+v info %+v; want id=%d leader=%d revision=%d members=%v", got, got.Info, id, leader, revision, members)
	}
}

func (s *suite) socialProxy(method, path string, value any) {
	s.t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(s.ctx, method, s.toxiproxy+path, bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
		s.t.Fatalf("toxiproxy %s %s: status %d", method, path, resp.StatusCode)
	}
}

func TestAllianceE2ESocialTeam(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 8*time.Minute)
	games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{})
	a := s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-team-a")
	name := s.prefix + "-player"
	proxy := fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", s.portBase+295)
	s.socialProxy("POST", "/proxies", map[string]any{"name": name, "listen": proxy, "upstream": games[1].client, "enabled": true})
	t.Cleanup(func() { s.socialProxy("DELETE", "/proxies/"+name, nil) })
	viaProxy := *games[1]
	viaProxy.client = proxy
	b := s.login(&viaProxy, s.prefix+"-team-b")
	created := call(a, msgid.MsgTeamCreate, &pb.TeamCreateRequest{}, pb.MarshalTeamCreateRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
	if created.Code != 0 || created.Info == nil || created.Info.TeamID == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("create: %+v", created)
	}
	id := created.Info.TeamID
	requireTeam(t, created, id, a.id, 1, a.id)
	invite := call(a, msgid.MsgTeamInvite, &pb.TeamInviteRequest{Invitee: b.id}, pb.MarshalTeamInviteRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
	requireTeam(t, invite, id, a.id, 1, a.id)
	// 跨 game 邀请通知不作前提：当前 TeamInvited 只投本进程，权威邀请仍允许持 TeamID 接受。
	// 下行无限 timeout 暂存所有回包，写入照常到达 game 1001。由另一进程读到提交后主动断开，形成真实丢回包。
	s.socialProxy("POST", "/proxies/"+name+"/toxics", map[string]any{"name": "lost-reply", "type": "timeout", "stream": "downstream", "toxicity": 1, "attributes": map[string]any{"timeout": 0}})
	raw, _ := pb.MarshalTeamAcceptRequest(&pb.TeamAcceptRequest{TeamID: id})
	b.mu.Lock()
	b.seq++
	seq := b.seq
	reply := make(chan *wire.Packet, 1)
	b.wait[seq] = reply
	b.mu.Unlock()
	if err := wire.Write(b.conn, []*wire.Packet{{MsgID: msgid.MsgTeamAccept, Seq: seq, Payload: raw}}, wire.DefaultMaxPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.eventually("cross-game accept committed despite lost reply", 20*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		got := teamInfo(a)
		return got.Code == 0 && got.Info != nil && got.Info.Revision == 2 && slices.Contains(got.Info.Members, b.id), fmt.Sprintf("%+v", got)
	})
	select {
	case <-reply:
		t.Fatal("toxiproxy did not withhold the accepted response")
	default:
	}
	_ = b.conn.Close()
	s.socialProxy("DELETE", "/proxies/"+name+"/toxics/lost-reply", nil)
	s.socialProxy("POST", "/proxies/"+name+"/toxics", map[string]any{"name": "latency", "type": "latency", "stream": "downstream", "toxicity": 1, "attributes": map[string]any{"latency": 80, "jitter": 20}})
	b = s.login(&viaProxy, s.prefix+"-team-b")
	retry := call(b, msgid.MsgTeamAccept, &pb.TeamAcceptRequest{TeamID: id}, pb.MarshalTeamAcceptRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
	requireTeam(t, retry, id, a.id, 2, a.id, b.id)
	requireTeam(t, teamInfo(a), id, a.id, 2, a.id, b.id)
	requireTeam(t, teamInfo(b), id, a.id, 2, a.id, b.id)
	blocked := call(b, msgid.MsgRehomeApply, &pb.RehomeApplyRequest{To: 1000}, pb.MarshalRehomeApplyRequest, pb.UnmarshalRehomeApplyResponse)
	if blocked.Code == 0 || blocked.TransferID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("team must block rehome: %+v", blocked)
	}
	// 整队跨 sid 不符合 module-duel 的本服契约，拒绝后不得留下任何排队意图。
	queue := call(a, msgid.MsgMatchEnqueue, &pb.MatchEnqueueRequest{Sequence: 1, Team: true}, pb.MarshalMatchEnqueueRequest, pb.UnmarshalMatchmakingResponse)
	if queue.Code == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cross-sid team unexpectedly queued: %+v", queue)
	}
	for _, p := range []*player{a, b} {
		if st := matchStatus(p); st.Code != 0 || st.Phase != "" || st.Key != "" {
			t.Fatalf("rejected team left intent: %+v", st)
		}
	}
	left := call(a, msgid.MsgTeamLeave, &pb.TeamLeaveRequest{}, pb.MarshalTeamLeaveRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
	if left.Code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("leader leave: %+v", left)
	}
	requireTeam(t, teamInfo(b), id, b.id, 3, b.id)
	if got := teamInfo(a); got.Code != 0 || got.Info == nil || got.Info.TeamID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("old leader reference: %+v", got)
	}
	t.Logf("SOCIAL_TEAM two game SIDs, lost accept reply + 80±20ms downstream, retry revision=2, leader transfer revision=3; cross-sid queue rejected without intent")
}

func matchStatus(p *player) *pb.MatchmakingResponse {
	return call(p, msgid.MsgMatchStatus, &pb.MatchStatusRequest{}, pb.MarshalMatchStatusRequest, pb.UnmarshalMatchmakingResponse)
}

func TestAllianceE2ESocialMatchmaking(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 8*time.Minute)
	games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{})
	a := s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-queue-a")
	b := s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-queue-b")
	queued := call(a, msgid.MsgMatchEnqueue, &pb.MatchEnqueueRequest{Sequence: 1}, pb.MarshalMatchEnqueueRequest, pb.UnmarshalMatchmakingResponse)
	if queued.Code != 0 || queued.Key == "" || queued.Phase != "queued" {
		t.Fatalf("enqueue: %+v", queued)
	}
	move := call(a, msgid.MsgRehomeApply, &pb.RehomeApplyRequest{To: 1001}, pb.MarshalRehomeApplyRequest, pb.UnmarshalRehomeApplyResponse)
	if move.Code == 0 || move.TransferID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("queue must block rehome: %+v", move)
	}
	team := call(a, msgid.MsgTeamCreate, &pb.TeamCreateRequest{}, pb.MarshalTeamCreateRequest, pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse)
	if team.Code == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("queue must block team join: %+v", team)
	}
	s.stop(games[0], syscall.SIGKILL)
	s.launch(games[0])
	s.waitReady(games[0], 2*time.Minute)
	a = s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-queue-a")
	b = s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-queue-b")
	resume := matchStatus(a)
	if resume.Code != 0 || resume.Key != queued.Key || resume.Sequence != 1 || resume.Phase != "queued" {
		t.Fatalf("QUEUE_RECOVERY: %+v want key=%s", resume, queued.Key)
	}
	retry := call(a, msgid.MsgMatchEnqueue, &pb.MatchEnqueueRequest{Sequence: 1}, pb.MarshalMatchEnqueueRequest, pb.UnmarshalMatchmakingResponse)
	if retry.Code != 0 || retry.Key != queued.Key {
		t.Fatalf("queue retry: %+v", retry)
	}
	peer := call(b, msgid.MsgMatchEnqueue, &pb.MatchEnqueueRequest{Sequence: 1}, pb.MarshalMatchEnqueueRequest, pb.UnmarshalMatchmakingResponse)
	if peer.Code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("peer enqueue: %+v", peer)
	}
	var room int64
	s.eventually("both players receive one match room", 30*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		x, y := matchStatus(a), matchStatus(b)
		if x.Code == 0 && y.Code == 0 && x.Phase == "matched" && y.Phase == "matched" && x.RoomID > 0 && x.RoomID == y.RoomID {
			room = x.RoomID
			return true, ""
		}
		return false, fmt.Sprintf("A=%+v B=%+v", x, y)
	})
	for _, p := range []*player{a, b} {
		for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
			st := matchStatus(p)
			if st.Code != 0 || st.RoomID != room || st.Phase != "matched" {
				t.Fatalf("matched replay changed room: %+v", st)
			}
		}
	}
	t.Logf("SOCIAL_MATCH queued key=%s survives game SIGKILL; retry produces one room=%d; team/rehome remain blocked until terminal clearance", queued.Key, room)
}

func TestAllianceE2ESocialRehome(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("DRILL_REHOME_FAULT_DIR", dir)
	s := newSuite(t, 12*time.Minute)
	games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{})
	leader := s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-rehome-leader")
	leader.addGold(1000)
	key := leader.startOp("found", &pb.FoundAllianceRequest{Name: "social rehome", OpenJoin: true})
	status := leader.waitOp("found", key, time.Minute)
	if status.Status != "completed" || status.AllianceID == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("found: %+v", status)
	}
	guild := status.AllianceID
	accounts, err := svcaccount.NewBusClient(s.bus, "", 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, stage := range []string{"handed-off", "committed"} {
		open := s.prefix + "-rehome-" + stage
		member := s.login(games[1], open)
		joined := call(member, msgid.MsgJoinAlliance, &pb.JoinAllianceRequest{AllianceID: guild}, pb.MarshalJoinAllianceRequest, pb.UnmarshalAllianceResponse)
		if joined.Code != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("join: %+v", joined)
		}
		member.addGold(200)
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"Stage": stage, "PlayerID": member.id})
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "arm.json"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		move := call(member, msgid.MsgRehomeApply, &pb.RehomeApplyRequest{To: 1000}, pb.MarshalRehomeApplyRequest, pb.UnmarshalRehomeApplyResponse)
		if move.Code != 0 || move.TransferID == "" {
			t.Fatalf("rehome apply: %+v", move)
		}
		var marker struct {
			Stage      string `json:"stage"`
			PID        int    `json:"pid"`
			PlayerID   int64  `json:"player_id"`
			TransferID string `json:"transfer_id"`
			From, To   int32
		}
		s.eventually("exact rehome "+stage, 30*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
			raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "reached.json"))
			if err != nil {
				return false, err.Error()
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &marker)
			return err == nil && marker.Stage == stage && marker.PlayerID == member.id, string(raw)
		})
		if marker.PID != games[1].cmd.Process.Pid || marker.TransferID != move.TransferID || marker.From != 1001 || marker.To != 1000 {
			t.Fatalf("wrong kill barrier: %+v", marker)
		}
		s.stop(games[1], syscall.SIGKILL)
		if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, "arm.json")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, "reached.json"))
		s.launch(games[1])
		s.waitReady(games[1], 2*time.Minute)
		if stage == "handed-off" {
			// account 尚未改绑；一次源登录是明确的恢复触发，不能宣称无人介入自动恢复。
			movingCode, _ := errcode.ClientError(apperrors.ErrRehomeMoving)
			member = s.login(games[1], open, movingCode)
		}
		s.eventually("account committed to target", time.Minute, func() (bool, string) {
			b, err := accounts.RoleBinding(s.ctx, member.id)
			return err == nil && b.ServerID == 1000 && b.ServingServerID == 1000, fmt.Sprintf("%+v %v", b, err)
		})
		elsewhereCode, _ := errcode.ClientError(apperrors.ErrPlayerElsewhere)
		refused := s.login(games[1], open, elsewhereCode)
		_ = refused.conn.Close()
		member = s.login(games[0], open)
		mine := member.guildInfo(0, joined.Version)
		if mine.Code != 0 || mine.AllianceID != guild || mine.Members != int32(i+2) {
			t.Fatalf("ALLIANCE_REHOME: target membership %+v", mine)
		}
		before, _ := s.funds(guild)
		donation := member.startOp("donate", &pb.DonateAllianceRequest{Amount: 25})
		if st := member.waitOp("donate", donation, time.Minute); st.Status != "completed" {
			t.Fatalf("target donate: %+v", st)
		}
		after, _ := s.funds(guild)
		if after-before != 25 || member.gold() != 175 {
			t.Fatalf("target saga funds=%d→%d (want +25)", before, after)
		}
		// 重登并重复查询同一 Saga 回执，不再扣款；联盟名单不会因换服多出一名成员。
		_ = member.conn.Close()
		member = s.login(games[0], open)
		if st := member.waitOp("donate", donation, time.Minute); st.Status != "completed" {
			t.Fatalf("replay receipt: %+v", st)
		}
		if again, _ := s.funds(guild); again != after {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate donation credit: %d→%d", after, again)
		}
		if info := leader.guildInfo(0, 0); info.Code != 0 || info.Members != int32(i+2) {
			t.Fatalf("leader membership: %+v", info)
		}
		t.Logf("SOCIAL_REHOME stage=%s killed_pid=%d player=%d transfer=%s target=1000 members=%d donate exactly once; Q4 old-source timers/writes not certified", stage, marker.PID, member.id, move.TransferID, i+2)
	}
}
